opening.argument: The presentation frames OneCoin as “THE BEST INVESTMENT 2015” and invites participation through paid entry packages. A €100 starter package is described as a way for everyone to enter, providing “one thousand tokens,” while higher packages are linked to projected euro values reaching “up to €2 million” for the Tycoon package. The presentation also describes multiple ways to earn within the system, with safer-algorithm, liquidity, and dashboard displays reinforcing its promotional context. These figures are forecasts rather than independently verified or realized returns, but the paid packages, token allocations, and substantial projected appreciation present OneCoin as an investment opportunity.
